_note: Single source of truth for what each tool may do. The agent loop reads 'category'; nothing in code hard-codes it.

tools.name: record_items
tools.description: Record decisions, action items, questions and facts heard in the input, each with exact quotes.

tools.name: judge_conflict
tools.description: Decide whether a new decision contradicts an earlier active decision, quoting both.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a task on the internal board in the To do column. Can be undone.

tools.name: preview_summary
tools.description: Draft the weekly digest for one person. Nothing is sent.

tools.name: publish_to_board
tools.description: Publish tasks to the shared team board where others see them.

tools.name: send_reminder
tools.description: Email a reminder to the task owner before the deadline.

tools.name: send_summary
tools.description: Email the weekly digest to one person.

tools.name: ask_team
tools.description: Email the team to resolve a conflict between two decisions.
